svg.title: Intestinal crypt and villus, villous atrophy
svg.desc: Longitudinal section of small-intestinal mucosa with coeliac-type villous atrophy: the villus is reduced to a broad low stump, the crypts are elongated and widened, intraepithelial lymphocytes lie between the surface enterocytes and the lamina propria is densely infiltrated, above the same crypt bases with Paneth and stem cells and the muscularis mucosae.
